text:
incident-bot: Pager — auth.verifier error rate spike detected (us-west-2). Metric: auth.verify.errors/total > 10% for the last 5m. Root cause suspected: 5xxs from Okta token verification endpoint; console logins showing ~12% failures. Paging oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: got it, I'm looking. can someone grab the runbook?

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/auth-verifier-outage (steps 1-7). Recommended initial checks: 1) okta key fetch errors, 2) rate limit headers, 3) token cache hit rate.

michelle_sre: checking logs now. I see a sudden jump in 500s from okta-auth-usw2: "502 Bad Gateway" when hitting /oauth2/v1/verify. Correlation: our token verifier service retried and then returned 502 to callers.

eng-anna: grabbing proxy (envoy) traces. Headers show `x-okta-rate-limit-remaining: 0` on some responses. Okta might be throttling per client_id.

oncall-ryan: ok, rate limit + 5xx. First mitigation: enable local verifier cache fallback for 10m for web-login flows (TTL bump), reduce verification QPS by 30% via temporary throttling at edge. Doing config change now.

julia_prod: product impact: customers report inability to log into console and some API calls failing with 401/500. Need top customers list for outreach. Support to prepare status message.

support-lex: preparing customer comms. Sending preliminary notice to affected accounts (those with >5 failed logins in last 15m). Will post public status update to status.redwood.ai: "Partial login failures in us-west-2; investigating."

eng-anna: applied edge throttle change and bumped local cache TTL to 10m for token verifier. Confirming config rollout.

oncall-ryan: rolling config across canaries now. Watch for secondary errors (stale tokens).

michelle_sre: after cache TTL bump, auth.verify error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% within two minutes. Console login success rate trending up. Still seeing sporadic 502s directly from Okta.

ops-bot: Reminder: if 3rd-party is rate-limited, consider offload to reserved verifier capacity/backfill with short-lived allowlist for console routes.

eng-anna: proposing fallback plan B: switch verification to our pre-warmed fallback service that uses cached JWKS and local verification (no call out) for console sessions older than 30s, to avoid additional Okta calls. This preserves security for short-lived sessions while we engage Okta.

oncall-ryan: authorize plan B for console-only paths. Eng-anna, proceed with feature flag and test on canary. Support-lex, hold customer comms until we confirm mitigations.

eng-anna: feature flag toggled on 2 canaries. I see 1.5% error rate on canary vs 4% in non-canary. Rolling to 50% now.

michelle_sre: oncall handover note: I'll stay watching for another 15m then hand to amber for overnight. Amber, you'll get the handoff once we stabilise.

oncall-amber: acknowledged. Will follow up with Okta support ticket if errors persist. Please add Okta request ID headers to the ticket.

support-lex: status.redwood.ai updated: "Mitigation in progress — partial login impact reduced. We are implementing a temporary fallback to reduce Okta calls." Adding affected customers list to the incident doc.

julia_prod: customer impact summary for execs: ~2.1k failed console login attempts during peak (12:05-12:25 UTC) across ~45 unique customers; business critical sign-ins impacted for 5 customers (we're contacting them directly).

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-091 (severity: P2). Paging schedule: Ryan -> Amber handoff in 20m.

oncall-ryan: quick note for post-incident: 1) add jitter/backoff to token-verifier call path, 2) implement circuit-breaker so we stop hammering Okta on transient 5xxs, 3) pre-warm JWKS and enforce caching TTLs.

eng-anna: logging snippet (from verifier):
```
ERROR auth.verifier - okta response 502 status=502 body="Bad Gateway" request_id=abc123 okta-host=okta-a-usw2
WARN auth.cache - cache miss for jwks-key-3
```

michelle_sre: outbound to Okta support: ticket #OKTA-98765 opened, including traces, x-request-id headers, and rate-limit headers. Okta replied: "Investigating a service disruption in region us-west-2 impacting token verification."

oncall-ryan: current status: mitigation in place (cache TTL + fallback flag). Error rate stable ~2-3%. No broader degradation. Handing off to Amber in 18m.

oncall-amber: received handoff. I will continue monitoring, verify Okta recovery, and coordinate postmortem. Please add any missed notes to the incident doc.

support-lex: final customer note draft for posting after recovery: "Login issues in US-WEST-2 caused by an upstream Okta service disruption. We implemented temporary local verification fallback to reduce impact. No credential compromise. Full postmortem to follow."

julia_prod: assigning postmortem owner: michelle_sre. Please include timeline, root cause, mitigation, and follow-ups (circuit-breaker, pre-warm, SLA request with Okta).

michelle_sre: acknowledged. Starting timeline and will create a pager duty action list.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-091 status: stabilizing. Next update in 1h or on major status change.
